dedupe_keys.name: synthetic meteosat mviri image generation code

description: The University of Marburg team publishes three Jupyter notebooks for harmonizing and synthesizing Meteosat visible-channel imagery in a public GitLab project under MIT. The own README orders resampling, Random Forest training and MFG image synthesis, with EUMETSAT MFG MVIRI and MSG SEVIRI inputs. A modeller could inspect this workflow before creating longer satellite reflectance series for climate or solar-resource context in infrastructure scenarios. Coverage follows central Europe and the 2006 to 2020 synthetic product described by the article. A caveat is that notebook execution depends on external EUMETSAT imagery and trained-model settings; metadata inspection does not prove that the published outputs can be reproduced. The related data_UMR landing page currently blocks inspection, so its own data archive is not marked trusted. I read the public GitLab metadata, tree, README, licence and article code statement without cloning or running notebooks. No directly related catalogue record was identified.
